market.description: Prices, changes and market capitalisation for the assets in the simulation.
market.chartDescription: Select a token in the table to chart it.
market.indexedNote: Each line is divided by its first value in the range, so both start at 100 and the gap shows relative performance.
market.compareLabel: {{a}} compared with {{b}}, indexed to 100 at the start of the {{range}} range
market.dominanceHint: Each tracked asset's share of the combined simulated market capitalisation.

networkPage.description: Health and performance of {{chain}}: block production, throughput and staking parameters.
networkPage.gasDescription: Gas used as a share of the block gas limit, last 60 blocks
networkPage.outcomeNote: Counted from the simulated blocks listed in the explorer.
networkPage.healthRule: “Healthy” means uptime of at least 99.8%, at least 95% of transactions succeeding and an average block time within 30% of the target. It is a simple rule over simulated numbers, not a statement about a real network.

devPage.description: Simulated developer activity around {{chain}}: contributions and the most active repositories.
devPage.weeklyHint: Contributions per week over the last year (simulated)
devPage.weekdayHint: Contributions over the last year, summed by day of the week
devPage.breakdownHint: Share of all commits across the active repositories for the selected period ({{period}})

dominancePage.description: How concentrated stake and market value are on {{chain}} and across the ecosystem.
dominancePage.votingPowerHint: Share of bonded stake held by the largest validators
dominancePage.marketCapHint: Share of the total simulated market capitalisation
dominancePage.cumulativeHint: Combined share of the top N validators
dominancePage.trendHint: Combined voting power of the largest validators over the last 30 days
dominancePage.trendSummary: The top 10 validators held {{then}} of the voting power 30 days ago and hold {{now}} today. Today {{n}} validators together can halt the chain.
dominancePage.trendLabel: Combined voting power of the top 10 validators: {{then}} 30 days ago, {{now}} today
